paper_metadata.title: Compositional regulation in additive manufacturing of precipitation-hardening (CoCrNi)94Ti3Al3 medium-entropy superalloy: Cellular structure stabilization and strength enhancement

evidence.quote: In this paper, we report new high strength γ′-hardened ((CoCrNi)94Ti3Al3)98Nb2 medium-entropy alloy through laser powder-bed fusion (L-PBF) followed by ageing.
